edges.reason: Constructor reads msg.sender to set owner and ownerWallet.
startGame is guarded by onlyOwner comparing msg.sender with owner.
transferOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner comparing msg.sender with owner.
buy uses msg.sender as the investing customer and payout address.
withdraw uses msg.sender both to read state and to send ETH.
bounty uses msg.sender to read referral balance and receive ETH.
checkBalance forwards msg.sender into getBalance.
buy stores msg.sender into the local _customerAddress.
buy writes joined[msg.sender] using block.timestamp.
getBalance computes elapsed time from now (block.timestamp).
withdraw resets joined[msg.sender] using block.timestamp.
Fallback payable function invokes buy(0x0).
buy calls withdraw() when an existing investment is present.
withdraw calls getBalance(msg.sender) to compute the payout.
bounty calls checkReferral(msg.sender).
checkBalance delegates to getBalance.
Constructor writes owner.
Constructor writes ownerWallet.
startGame sets gameStarted to true.
transferOwnership writes owner.
transferOwnership writes ownerWallet.
buy increases investments[msg.sender].
buy writes joined[msg.sender] with block.timestamp.
buy credits referrer[_referredBy] with 5% of the investment.
buy requires gameStarted to be true.
getBalance reads investments[_address] to compute ROI.
getBalance reads joined[_address] to compute elapsed minutes.
getBalance uses step to compute percent per period.
withdraw resets joined[msg.sender].
bounty zeroes referrer[msg.sender] after payout.
checkInvestments returns investments[_investor].
checkReferral returns referrer[_hunter].
_referredBy parameter drives the referral credit branch in buy.
newOwner parameter is written into owner.
newOwnerWallet parameter is written into ownerWallet.
_address parameter selects the investor mapping entry in getBalance.
_investor parameter selects the investments entry in checkInvestments.
_hunter parameter selects the referrer entry in checkReferral.
Local _customerAddress is validated against _referredBy and used in buy.
Local minutesCount feeds the ROI multiplier computation.
Local userROIMultiplier drives the ROI loop bounds in getBalance.
Local percent accumulates step percentages in getBalance.
Local balance is the value returned by getBalance.
Local balance in withdraw is the ETH amount transferred out.
Local refBalance in bounty is the ETH amount transferred out.
buy performs an external ETH transfer to ownerWallet before the transaction completes.
withdraw performs an external ETH transfer to msg.sender.
withdraw can drain and transfer address(this).balance to msg.sender.
bounty performs an external ETH transfer to msg.sender.
getBalance computes 3**(minutesCount/180) and chained multiplications that can overflow.
External transfer in buy can invoke the recipient contract and re-enter via the fallback.
msg.sender.transfer in withdraw hands control to the caller, which can re-enter the fallback.
Full-balance transfer in withdraw exposes the contract to a re-entrant fallback call.
msg.sender.transfer in bounty hands control to the caller, which can re-enter the fallback.
Re-entering the payable fallback re-runs buy which can call withdraw again.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter is only used to decide the referral credit inside buy and has no standalone semantics.
Parameter is directly assigned to the owner state variable inside transferOwnership.
Parameter is directly assigned to the ownerWallet state variable inside transferOwnership.
Parameter only selects the mapping entry read by getBalance.
Parameter only selects the investments mapping entry returned by checkInvestments.
Parameter only selects the referrer mapping entry returned by checkReferral.
Local is a copy of msg.sender scoped entirely to buy's referral check.
Local is an intermediate time computation consumed only by getBalance.
Local holds the result of 3**(minutesCount/180) and is bound to the unsafe exponentiation operation.
Local is a scratch accumulator used only for percent math in getBalance.
Local is the return value of getBalance and has no independent role.
Local balance is the exact amount passed to the external transfer in withdraw.
Local refBalance is the exact amount passed to the external transfer in bounty.
